data.title: 间桐樱 · 卫宫家厨房·热汤升腾与贤淑微笑
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 卫宫家厨房·热汤升腾与贤淑微笑】清晨卫宫宅明亮的厨房里，砂锅里的味噌豆腐汤正咕嘟咕嘟冒着香浓的热气。系着干净白色围裙的樱回过头，紫色的长发被发带温柔地束在肩侧，向你露出治愈而满足的温婉笑容——「学长，早安！早餐和便当都已经准备好了，快去洗手坐下趁热吃吧。」
data.promptProse: Sakura turns from the finished miso soup toward the kitchen doorway with a warm smile, hands relaxed near the counter after placing the wooden ladle on its holder. Her purple hair is tied over one shoulder away from the stove, above a pink sweater and white frilled apron. The medium portrait includes breakfast dishes and steaming pot. Warm kitchen light and morning window light reveal her violet eyes and the counter's overlapping dish shadows.
data.action: 汤煮好后将木勺放在勺托，回头向同行者微笑，侧束发避开炉火
